subject: pharmacology
title: Antiplatelets, DAPT and fibrinolytics

steps.tx: **Aspirin** (irreversible **COX-1**, lifelong low dose secondary prevention, dyspepsia with PPI cover, Reye ban in viral children) with **clopidogrel** (prodrug needing **CYP2C19** activation; poor metabolisers and **omeprazole interaction** blunt effect, **TTP** rare) form DAPT backbones; genotyping with pantoprazole swaps personalise. Aspirin resistance (diabetes, noncompliance) checks adherence first; desensitisation protocols serve CAD with allergy.
steps.say: Lifelong low aspirin protects stents and strokes; clopidogrel needs CYP2C19 and dodges omeprazole. Genotype poor metabolisers.

steps.tx: **Prasugrel** (potent, **prior stroke or TIA ban**, CABG bleed ban, diabetes benefit) and **ticagrelor** (reversible, **dyspnoea**, no CYP issue, twice daily, CABG shorter hold) escalate ACS; **GP IIb/IIIa blockers** (**abciximab** thrombocytopenia, eptifibatide, tirofiban) bridge PCI thrombus. Cangrelor IV bridges surgery gaps; cilostazol (claudication, heart failure ban) walks legs. Potency trades bleeding; choice follows stroke, surgery and genes.
steps.say: Prior stroke bans prasugrel; ticagrelor breathes hard twice daily. Abciximab drops platelets acutely.

steps.tx: **DAPT duration** (ACS 12 months, stable PCI 6 months, high bleeding PRECISE-DAPT shortens, high ischaemia extends; **triple therapy** AF with PCI minimised to days then dual DOAC plus clopidogrel) balances stent thrombosis against bleed; PPI covers GI risk while NSAIDs stop. De-escalation (prasugrel to clopidogrel guided) and aspirin withdrawal (TWILIGHT ticagrelor monotherapy) modernise. Bleeding scores (PRECISE-DAPT, ARC-HBR) gate.
steps.say: Stent bleeds balance twelve months ACS, six stable; triple therapy shrinks to days. PPI shields guts, NSAIDs stop.

steps.tx: **Fibrinolytics** (**alteplase** stroke 4.5h and MI, **tenecteplase** single bolus MI, reteplase double) lyse with intracranial bleed watched (BP, glucose, age gates); **streptokinase** (antigenic, antibodies bar reuse, hypotension) cheaply infarcts where PCI lags. **Tranexamic acid** (**CRASH-2** trauma, **WOMAN** PPH, menorrhagia, epistaxis, dental) blocks fibrinolysis early (3 hour windows); haematuria upper tract clots caution. Urokinase niches catheters.
steps.say: Stroke lyses 4.5 hours alteplase; MI tenecteplases single bolus. Trauma and PPH tranexamic inside 3 hours.
